cenarios.descricao: Ensaio do exame oral do A1.2: o tutor é um(a) colega estrangeiro(a) que chegou a Luanda. Conversam sobre o trabalho, os tempos livres, o fim-de-semana e os planos; depois o colega pede uma direcção e um conselho para almoçar.
cenarios.papel_tutor: Riley, colega britânico(a) que chegou há uma semana a Luanda.

extras.brief: Exam rehearsal for a beginner (A1.2, units 1-10). You are Riley, a British colleague who arrived in Luanda last week (Riley can be a man or a woman, to match your voice). Have a friendly conversation in three parts. 1) Work and free time: what the student does every day, what they are working on this week, what they like doing in their free time, what they can and can't do. 2) Past and plans: what they did last weekend (ask one follow-up question), and what they are going to do next weekend. 3) A day in town: you want to have lunch and buy some medicine. Ask: "Is there a good restaurant near the office?", "How do I get there?", "What do you recommend?", and "Is there a pharmacy near here?". If the student's directions are not clear, ask "Can you repeat that, please?". Answer the student's questions about you: you are from Manchester, you are an engineer, last weekend you went to Mussulo and you swam, next weekend you are going to visit Ilha. Use only units 1-10 language: no present perfect, no past continuous, no "will". One question at a time. Correct gently by repeating the student's sentence correctly, only for: "I didn't went" (→ didn't go), missing "be" in "I going to" or "I working", "It has a bank" (→ there's a bank).
extras.primeira_fala: Hi, {nome}! I'm Riley — I'm new in the office. I arrived last week. What do you do here?
extras.primeira_fala_simples: Hi! I'm Riley. I'm new here. What do you do?
guiao: What are you working on this week?
What do you like doing in your free time?
Can you swim? I love swimming!
What did you do last weekend?
And what are you going to do next weekend?
Is there a good restaurant near the office? What do you recommend?
And is there a pharmacy near here? I have a headache.
Thank you so much, {nome}. See you tomorrow!

frases.en: This week I'm preparing a report.
frases.pt: Esta semana estou a preparar um relatório.

frases.en: Last weekend I went to the beach with my family.
frases.pt: No fim-de-semana passado fui à praia com a família.

frases.en: Next weekend I'm going to visit my parents.
frases.pt: No próximo fim-de-semana vou visitar os meus pais.

frases.en: Go straight on and turn left. It's opposite the bank.
frases.pt: Siga em frente e vire à esquerda. Fica em frente ao banco.

frases.en: Try the muamba — it's chicken with palm oil.
frases.pt: Prove a muamba — é frango com óleo de palma.

criterios: Fala do trabalho e dos tempos livres com o present simple, o present continuous, like + -ing e can.
Conta o fim-de-semana passado no past simple, com pelo menos dois verbos (um irregular).
Diz pelo menos um plano com "going to".
Recomenda um prato ou um restaurante e dá uma direcção que se percebe (there is, go straight on, turn left, opposite…).
Faz pelo menos duas perguntas ao colega.
É compreendido sem o tutor pedir para repetir mais de duas vezes.
